name: gpu-pulse
description: Live GPU, CPU and memory dashboard with usage averages, utilization insights and machine specs. Works on Windows, Linux, macOS and Remote-SSH.

commands.title: GPU Pulse: Show in Side Bar
GPU Pulse: Mute Alerts for 1 Hour

gpuPulse.sampleIntervalMs.description: Sampling interval while the dashboard is visible (milliseconds). NVIDIA GPUs are read through one long-lived nvidia-smi process, so short intervals stay cheap.

gpuPulse.backgroundIntervalMs.description: Sampling interval while the dashboard is hidden. Usage history keeps recording at this rate.

gpuPulse.recordInBackground.description: Keep recording usage history while the dashboard is closed. Turn off on laptops to let a discrete GPU sleep (the status bar, if enabled, still polls).

gpuPulse.historyDays.description: How many days of per-minute usage history to keep.

gpuPulse.statusBar.enabled.description: Show live GPU usage in the status bar.

gpuPulse.nvidiaSmiPath.description: Custom path to nvidia-smi. Leave empty to search PATH and standard install locations.

gpuPulse.temperatureWarning.description: GPU temperature (°C) at which the status bar and dashboard warn, and the threshold of the "running hot" alert.

gpuPulse.alerts.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a notification when a GPU runs hot, fills its VRAM, sits idle while holding memory, or finishes a job. Alerts are evaluated on every sample, also while the dashboard and side bar are hidden — but only while sampling runs: with both `#gpuPulse.statusBar.enabled#` and `#gpuPulse.recordInBackground#` off, sampling pauses when no view is visible and no alerts are raised. Each alert fires once per episode, with a 30 min cooldown per alert and GPU.

gpuPulse.alerts.hot.markdownDescription: Warn when a GPU stays at or above `#gpuPulse.temperatureWarning#` for 30 s (re-arms once it drops 3 °C below).

gpuPulse.alerts.vramFull.description: Warn when a GPU's VRAM stays at or above 95% for 20 s (re-arms below 90%).

gpuPulse.alerts.idleHeld.markdownDescription: Notify when a GPU stays below 10% utilization while holding at least 50% of its VRAM for `#gpuPulse.alerts.idleHeldMinutes#` (often an open notebook or a finished script). Re-arms at 15% utilization or below 40% VRAM.

gpuPulse.alerts.jobFinished.markdownDescription: Notify when a busy stretch (utilization at or above 15%, dips under 60 s bridged) of at least `#gpuPulse.alerts.jobFinishedMinutes#` ends with 60 s below 10%.

gpuPulse.alerts.idleHeldMinutes.description: Minutes a GPU must be idle while holding VRAM before the idle alert fires.

gpuPulse.alerts.jobFinishedMinutes.description: Minimum length (minutes) of a busy stretch for the job-finished alert.
